question: Among users who have posted comments with a score of 0, identify the one who owns the post created in 2010 with the highest view count among all posts that exceed the average view count. Return the user's display name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT c.XCL_010
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.XCL_007 = 0
)
AND strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
AND p.XCL_030 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_030) FROM posts)
ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
LIMIT 1;
